protocol.name: v7-conductance-order-comparison-v1
protocol.rest_protocol: 32 frames x 4 substeps; finite adaptation, not proven equilibrium
protocol.change: type threshold after mean versus source threshold before same weighted sum
protocol.normalization: shared label-free calibration within each retinal backend
protocol.stimulus_role: reused regression battery, not independent validation

truth_table.inputs: synthetic normalized source values, not measured resting activity

limitations: Source-wise release is a model hypothesis, not measured transmitter kinetics.
Synthetic tonic input verifies algebra but cannot calibrate real resting activity.
A frame-difference encoder has no absolute constant-luminance input.
Per-source-type normalization still discards relative between-type weight mass.
All-cell gates remain separate from algebraic truth-table checks.
